services.desc: John Rolfe was one of the first English settlers in Virginia. He went to the colony of Jamestown around 1610 and is credited with developing the strain of tobacco that became Virginia's staple crop. In 1614 he married the Indian Princess Pocahontas, whom he later took to England. After her death in 1617, Rolfe returned to America, where he was killed in a war with the Powhatan Indians in 1622. Pocahontas was said to be a beautiful and intelligent Indian Princess. The daughter of the Indian Chief Powhatan, of the POWHATAN confederacy of Virginia. Her personal clan name was Matoaka. In 1608, John Smith, one of the founders of the Jamestown settlement in Virginia, was captured by the Indians
